summary: At the briefing, {person} asks who has spoken to the tribe about the water's importance beyond its present-day land boundary.
realLife: The April proclamation directed agencies to consult tribes on drought preparation on tribal lands and effects on cultural resources in their ancestral lands.
gates: A tribal consultation record distinguishes an affected resource from the administrative boundary.
